He needs to see that you spend most of your time doing normal things-like maintaining the Falcon , or hiding in the corner with Han at diplomatic ceremonies.|[[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] to her husband [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] referring to [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]]|<ref name="A Forest Apart">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>}}
'''Holoadventures''' were presumably a type of story or [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] following the adventures of a hero. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] compared her husband, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] usual life style to that of such an adventure.
